title: Semantic vs. Exact Metadata Search Gap
subtitle: Extracted from 71 discovery clusters · High-severity drop-off when memory anchors are missing
pain_points: Inability to search photos using conceptual or visual descriptions
Receiving entirely wrong results when users misremember the exact location or date
Forced to manually scroll through years of timeline grid to find a specific event
Blank search results ('zero_results') when using descriptive keywords
Face recognition failing for older, scanned, or non-human subjects
pm_opportunities: Implement true Semantic Search (embeddings) to map vague concepts to visual data
Introduce natural language query parsing (e.g., 'that hike I took with a red jacket')
Provide fallback fuzzy-matching when exact dates/locations are missing
Allow users to search by objects, activities, emotions, or color palettes
Surface contextual filters instantly when a generic keyword fails

top_quotes.quote: when I try to find photos from a specific spot like a viewpoint or trail, it only groups by city, not the exact location.
scrolling through years of photos one by one is the only option left
Why can't I easily search through photos using a keyword?

title: Information Architecture & Album Retrieval Friction
subtitle: Extracted from App Store & Play Store reviews · Secondary evidence corroborating taxonomy failures
pain_points: Users forget album names, leading to duplicate albums or lost collections
Overwhelming 'too_many_results' when searching broad geographical tags
Inability to combine filters (e.g., 'Person X' + 'Location Y')
Poor distinction between device folders vs. cloud-synced albums
Loss of context when photos are shared or downloaded without original metadata
pm_opportunities: Auto-generate intelligent smart collections based on recurring people and places
Implement multi-faceted search UI (combining who + where + when)
Provide visual clustering on maps rather than just text-based city tags
Improve album visibility and allow hierarchical folder nesting
Prompt users to tag or group photos post-event to prevent future memory gaps

top_quotes.quote: No map to find 'by place' and 'places' too general (whole city!)
Face recognition/face grouping not working for older photos.
